All.name: Arcane Training
All.description:
You have spend your time studying magic to compete with those that have magical gifts. 
Learn two level 2 [Arcane Feats]. 
Your proficiency level in arcana increases (max Expert)
All.unlockedFeats: Arcane Feat - Level 2, Arcane Feat - Level 2

All.name: Attunement
All.description:
You have an attunement, a magical connection through your soul to one aspect of magic. 
This makes it easier to cast that type of magic, but prevents you from casting the opposite aspect. 
Spells from your attuned aspect are called attuned spells  
-While casting attuned spells, reduce their mana cost by their rank
-While casting attuned spells, you may also use your WIL instead of INT for the spellshaping check.
-You cannot learn or cast spells of the opposite aspect from your attunement
Get the [Basic Elemental Magic] arcane feat for your attuned aspect

All.name: Crafting Prodigy
All.description:
You are specialized in one field of crafting above everything else and are able to craft things that would normally be above your level of knowledge. 
You learn one of the [Armor Artificer], [Artificer´s Weapon] or [Runegun Smith] feats, ignoring their level requirements. 
When picking new feats you treat feats from your chosen archetype as if their level requirements were 2 levels lower. 
Additionally you become trained in crafting and have a +3 bonus to any checks regarding your field.

All.name: Experienced
All.description:
You've spent your time doing a variety of things. 
Gain one more background and one level 1 [General Feat]

All.name: Voidchild
All.description:
Marked by the void, feared by living.
You ignore the Complex trait on spells with the Void trait.
You learn spells equal to your INT
You have +3 bonus on saves against effects with the Void or Soul traits
Voidchildren have starry purple eyes and faintly glowing skin
NOTE: Voidchildren are outlawed in the Draconium and some other countries and will be hunted on sight

All.name: Large Mana Well
All.description:
You have an larger than average mana well, allowing you to cast more spells and increasing the strength of your aura. 
Increase your maximum Mana by your WIL
Every time you level up your maximum mana increases by 2 more

All.name: Remnant Connection
All.description:
You have a rare and mysterious connection to the Remnant, an ancient civilization which left ruins all of Kastorix, which helps you in small ways.
Once per day you may choose to reroll a failed roll, you must keep the new one even if its worse.
Certain artifacts and creatures may treat you differently.

All.name: Soulsight
All.description:
You posses the rare gift of natural soulsight, allowing you to see souls. Souls appear as tiny dots of light in the center of living creatures. 
You have the Inspect Soul action. You may spend a focus point to use it as a free action
All.unlockedAction:
Inspect Soul - 1 Action
Target one creature you can see within 6 tiles. Looking at a creatures soul you perceive a few details about it. You learn if it has
An attunement, and if so which aspect.
A soulbond. You can make a DC 20 arcana check to try to figure out the nature of the soulbond.
Whether any other soul magic is affecting the target, though you don't know what type it is.
If the creature is an illusion, or a object or golem made to look like a creature you get no information about it, but see that it's not a creature

All.name: Swift
All.description:
You have 1 tile extra movement speed and may add your DEX again to initiative checks. 
Your proficiency level in Reflex saves increases one step (max Master)

All.name: Tough
All.description:
Your tougher than most. 
Increase your maximum health by 3 + your PHY.  
Twice per day when you reduce your exhaustion you may also restore your health equal to your PHY
Your proficiency level in fortitude saves increases one step (max Expert)

All.name: Force of Personality
All.description:
Your proficiency level in persuasion and intimidation increases one step (max Master).
You may use WIL for intimidation checks.
When you cast spells you may spend mana equal to their rank to increase their initial DC's by that much.

All.name: Golemcrafter
All.description:
Your proficiency level in golem lore and crafting increases (max Expert). 
You have created a golem companion that follows you around. 
See the golem companion page for more information. 
If it is reduced to 0 hit points it is disabled and can be repaired with an hours work at a workbench.
Once per turn, when you or your Golem takes an action, the other one can take one as a free action

All.name: Soulbond
All.description:
You have a soulbonded with a magical creature giving you a direct connection to it.
The creature you can soulbond with depends on your level, as more powerful creatures require stronger magical power.
See the soulbonding page for more information. 
You can only have one soulbond at a time, and if your soulbond dies you take 2d6 vital damage.

All.name: Magical Genius
All.description:
You learn extra spells of all ranks you know equal to your INT. 
You also learn Metamagics equal to your INT
You may attempt to copy a spell (of a rank you can cast) you saw last turn,  casting the spell even without being proficient with it.

All.name: Nimble as a Fox
All.description:
Once per turn you may use a focus point to take on of the Step, Stand Up, Hide, Take Cover, Tumble Through or Steal as a free actions. 
The first time each day you critical success on a Tumble Through, Steal or Reflex Save you regain one focus point
Your proficiency level in Reflex saves increases one step (max Master)

All.name: Physical Might
All.description:
You add half your PHY again on weapon damage rolls, or if the weapon is two handed you add your full PHY again instead. 
Your proficiency level in athletics or brawling increases one step (max Master)

All.name: Protective Aura
All.description:
Your aura absorbs more of the energy of incoming attacks.
While you aura has above half health you can aura block without using your reaction

All.name: Reactive
All.description:
Your reaction speed is faster than others. 
You have two reactions per round. 
You can only use one reaction for each creatures turn.

All.name: Faster Than The Eye
All.description:
Your so fast your movements can't even be perceived by some.
Your movespeed increases by 1.
If your movespeed + 5 is higher than a creature's passive perception, they can't see you move and take reactions to it.

All.name: Peerless Master
All.description:
You stand beyond the rest in the fields you've trained in. 
You have +1 bonus to all checks you've are trained, increasing to +2 if you are have mastery in them
